name: B & A Packaging India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, B&A Packaging India Ltd manufactures and sells Paper-sack and Flexi-pack[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a part of B&A Group[2] which is into tea broking, heritage tourism including a golf resort. Company deals in Paper sacks, Multiwall sacks and Flexible laminates manufacturing business

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.7% over past five years.
